comment: Amazing professor. He knows his stuff and has a real passion for teaching/learning. If you put in the time/effort, it's definitely worth it. Tough grader, but you'll learn a ton about the subject/yourself through his class.

I have had 3 classes with Dr. Leary. He is a tough grader. But if you seek help, he will be more than happy to work with you. If you put the time into his class, getting an A is def possible. Def a brilliant prof and is so far the best one I have ever had. He does like to talk alot though has you to write 1 page summaries but they are really help.

He's brilliant, and consequently a 50 minute class with him is jammed with info. He likes to talk. A lot. Don't expect a lot of discussion, but be sure to try and get a word in because there is a participation grade! He is a very difficult grader, but he genuinely cares about his students and will do anything he can to help his students.

Flat out great professor if you go into his class with the right attitude. Very challenging because he expects a lot from his students and cares about his profession. You can learn a lot from his class if you pay close attention to readings and discussions.

Reading reports help with essays but really take up too much time to be considered truly beneficial.  He's smart yes but if your writing style differs from his he will straight up mark you down to china town

Very interested in his students, accessible and, as noted, exceptionally intelligent. Asks much of his students, has a tough grading policy, but will help you to take a lot from CORE (if you wish to read beforehand and discuss in class).

you have to write a page or two for every class which gets to be a pain in the ass. the man is borderline genius and can talk intelligently about anyone you read from Plato to Darwin. tought essay grader, make sure of the small details

Okay, to begin, this guy is brilliant. However, for CORE at least, he is a strenuous grader on essays, not a good discussion leader dispite great insights, won't help you worth jack on your essays. If you're a great writer, just go to class and do the homework and you're set.
haha good luck...this professor does not give out A's, he makes core worse than it already is...very intelligent, very boring.  get used to seeing B's in this class.
pretty boring very dependent on good class participation...and interesting classmates...

Harsh grader on essays. Though he is the most intelligent professor i've met (note im only a wee apple-eyed freshman) and interesting, he expects a lot out of his students. He does a good job of turning psycho-babble that you read into clear thoughts tho, so thats where the clarity grade is from.
Most work out of any core class. Reading reports for every class. Exams are take home and are not easy. Don't expect higher than a C unless you work your butt off. Nice guy though.
boring...need class input to interrupt him during his long random tangents..but overall real pretty nice and helpful...hopefully a lively class will enhance discussions....
